item.title: Court rules NY's efforts to censor pro-life pregnancy centers unconstitutional
item.description: An appeals court panel has ruled that efforts to stop pro-life pregnancy centers in New York from informing patients about abortion pill reversal are unconstitutional, as such organizations find themselves increasingly subject to investigations from Democratic politicians. #FirstAmendment #Abortion #NewYork #LetitiaJames #AllianceDefendingFreedom

item.title: Milo Yiannopoulos regrets 'mainstreaming homosexuality' in GOP: 'I feel ashamed'
item.description: Conservative political commentator Milo Yiannopoulos recently expressed regret for "mainstreaming homosexuality in the Republican Party" a decade ago, and claimed hidden homosexuality is rampant in conservative political circles. #MiloYiannopoulos #TuckerCarlson #homosexuality #LGBT #conversiontherapy #RepublicanParty

item.title: Ex-wife of Hillsong’s first black American lead pastor claims he was extorted by transgender prostitute
item.description: The ex-wife of Hillsong Church's first black lead pastor insists his infidelity led to him being extorted by a trans-identified male prostitute, to whom she claims he paid $10,000 to keep quiet, even though he denies being unfaithful during his marriage. #SamCollier #ToniCollier #HillsongChurch #ChristianCulturalCenter #Megachurch

item.title: Croatian nun’s claim she was stabbed by migrant was fabricated, police say
item.description: Police in Croatia say a nun who claimed she was stabbed by a migrant fabricated the story. The announcement followed several days of public speculation and political debate over the reported attack. #Croatia #AllahuAkbar #Migrants #SistersofCharityofStVincentdePaulCroatia

item.title: Christian relief groups mobilize after deadly storms impact millions, kill over 1,000 in Asia
item.description: Christian relief organizations worldwide have rushed to provide assistance after widespread flooding and landslides killed over 1,100 people and displaced well over 1 million others throughout Indonesia, Sri Lanka, Thailand and Malaysia this week. #SriLanka #Indonesia #Caritas #GFAWorld #ConvoyofHope #BaptistWorldAid

item.title: Samaritan’s Purse plane hijacked; suspect in custody
item.description: A Samaritan's Purse plane carrying aid to South Sudan was hijacked earlier this week. A suspect has been detained, and no serious injuries are being reported. #SamaritansPurse #hijacking #plane #Sudan #Graham #aid #SouthSudan

item.title: 4 things to know about Texas' new 'bathroom bill'
item.description: Starting Dec. 4, a new Texas law prohibiting men from entering women's restrooms will go into effect. #Texas #BathroomBill #LGBT

item.title: YouVersion reveals top Bible verse of 2025
item.description: YouVersion, the most downloaded Bible app in the world, has revealed the top Bible verse of 2025 as its team reflects on a year of record-breaking Bible engagement worldwide. #YouVersion #2025 #BobbyGruenewald #Isaiah4110 #Bible

item.title: World Relief 'cannot confirm' if it assisted National Guard shooter under refugee resettlement programs
item.description: The Evangelical aid charity World Relief says it “cannot confirm” if it provided assistance in the resettlement of an Afghan national to the U.S. who later shot two National Guard members, killing one. #WorldRelief #NationalGuard #DCShooting

item.title: Trump FBI, DOJ announce arrest of pipe bomb suspect after nearly 5 years at large
item.description: A suspect in attempted pipe bombings in Washington, D.C., has been arrested after remaining at large for nearly five years as an investigation into his motives continues. #pipebomber #PamBondi #Jan6 #DNC #RNC
